actionData.xqlPhrase:
config case_sensitive = false
| dataset = endpoints
| fields operational_status_description as osd, endpoint_name, group_names, operational_status, operating_system, agent_version, last_seen, content_version, endpoint_status, last_content_update_time, manual_protection_pause, linux_operation_mode, endpoint_type, kernel_version, platform, tags 
| filter operational_status != PROTECTED 
| filter endpoint_status in (ENUM.CONNECTED, ENUM.DISCONNECTED) and platform != $x_axis.value and operational_status = $y_axis.name 
| alter OSD_reason = arraymap(json_extract_array(to_json_string(osd),"$."),json_extract_scalar("@element", "$.reason")) 
| arrayexpand OSD_reason 
| dedup endpoint_name, OSD_reason 
| fields endpoint_name, OSD_reason ,operational_status, agent_version, last_seen, content_version, endpoint_status, last_content_update_time, manual_protection_pause, linux_operation_mode, endpoint_type, kernel_version
